app.name: Traveler
nav.label: Main
footer.privacy: Your saved festivals, language and location stay on this device.
footer.ai: An AI checks the dates against official sources and the national press; a change goes live only when it passes those checks, and doubtful ones are held back.
offline.notice: You're offline. You're seeing the data this device kept from your last visit.
offline.pageBody: This device hasn't saved the calendar yet. Connect once and it will work offline.
today.override: Simulated date: {date}. Countdowns use that day.
ics.description: Status: {status}. Date source: {confidence}. Details, sources and changes: {url}
date.moonEstimate: Estimated, may shift by a day: it depends on the moon until the official announcement.
error.offlineBody: Check your connection. Countries you already visited open without internet.
error.dataBody: The file arrived damaged. Try again in a moment.
draft.banner: Draft, not approved: a person hasn't reviewed this data yet.
scope.title: Where do you want to see festivals?
scope.more: Any other country can be built: open it and choose «Build».
scope.searchLabel: Search a country or a festival
scope.searchHint: Type in English, Spanish or Portuguese; accents don't matter.
scope.noData: Not built yet: open it to build
scope.noResults: Nothing matches “{query}”. Try the name in another language.
home.emptyTitle: Nothing big in the next 12 months
home.emptyBody: Tier 2 adds mid-sized festivals and the ones still being measured.
home.unpublishedBody: Building it researches its biggest festivals and checks each date against official sources or the national press. It goes live with at least 3 sourced dates.
home.pilot: Live so far: {countries}. Any other country can be built from its page.
home.pilotMany: {count} countries live. Any other country can be built from its page.
build.queuedBody: Its biggest festivals and their dates are being researched and checked. It usually goes live within a day, or early next month if this month's budget is used up.
build.retryBody: Not enough festival dates were found on official sources or the national press. Next try: {date}.
build.gaveUpBody: Three tries didn't find enough festival dates with a reliable source. You can ask again.
fresh.stale: Data for {country} was last verified on {date} ({days}). Check the date at the source before you buy.
fresh.never: Data for {country} has no verification date yet.
fresh.partial: Partial coverage: {share} of the dates come from the organizer or the government.
timeline.title: The next 12 months
timeline.empty: No festivals in these 12 months for this view.
marks.lede: Every date says how sure it is and where it comes from.
filters.tripHint: Only festivals that overlap your dates are shown.
filters.countHelp: The number is how many festivals you'd see if you pick it.
explore.title: Explore
explore.worldHint: Worldwide view: only the biggest (Tier 1). Pick a country to also see its top 5.
explore.emptyBody: Widen the search with one of these options.
near.title: Near me
near.privacy: Optional. Your location is used only on this device to sort by distance, and it's forgotten when you close the tab.
near.denied: You didn't allow location access. Everything else works the same.
near.unavailable: This device couldn't give us your location. Everything else works the same.
near.needTitle: Sorting by distance needs your location
near.needBody: It's used only on this device and never sent anywhere.
festival.eventUnsourced: The edition's source doesn't give this day.
festival.street: How to live it on the street
festival.noSources: This edition has no published source yet. The date comes from the rule: {rule}.
rule.announced: no fixed rule; it usually falls between {from} and {to}
measure.calle.mayoria_gratis: Most events free and open to join
measure.calle.mixta: A mix of free and ticketed events
score.title: Why it made the list
score.rangeWhy: A range because some criteria are still being measured.
score.unmeasuredDesc: No sourced figure yet: it counts as 0 and the total shows as a range (up to {max} more).
calendar.title: Add to calendar
calendar.appleDetail: Downloads an .ics file that works with other calendars too
calendar.unconfirmedNote: The date isn't confirmed yet: the event carries “{prefix}” in its title.
calendar.noDate: {name} has no announced date yet, so there's no day to add.
calendar.noDateSubscribe: Subscribe to the {country} calendar: it shows up on its own once announced.
subscribe.title: {country} calendar
subscribe.body: Subscribe once and the dates update themselves in your calendar app.
advisory.title: Before you travel
advisory.body: Read the official {origin} travel advice for {country}. This app doesn't rate safety.
advisory.bodyConsular: Read the official {origin} consular information for travel to {country}. This app doesn't rate safety.
advisory.missing: We don't have a verified {origin} travel advice link for {country} yet. Look for it on your foreign ministry's site.
report.title: Something wrong?
report.body: A GitHub form opens with the festival, the field and the source filled in. We reply within 48 hours.
suggest.title: Missing a festival?
suggest.body: Propose a big street festival with a source. A GitHub form opens and we review suggestions every month.
saved.title: Saved
saved.undated.one: {count} has no date yet and isn't in the file; it will appear once announced.
saved.undated.other: {count} have no date yet and aren't in the file; they will appear once announced.
saved.missing.one: {count} saved festival is no longer in the published data.
saved.missing.other: {count} saved festivals are no longer in the published data.
saved.emptyTitle: You haven't saved any festivals yet
saved.emptyBody: Tap a festival's bookmark to keep it here, even offline.
saved.notPersistent: This browser won't store data: your changes last until you close the tab.
settings.title: Settings
settings.originHint: Used to link your country's official travel advice on each festival.
about.title: About the data
about.lede: Which festivals make the list, how we know their dates and how fresh each country's data is.
about.howBody: Five criteria add up to 100 points on the same scale in every country, so a village festival and a capital's carnival are compared by the same rule.
about.criterion.convocatoria: Attendees or visitors in the latest official count.
about.criterion.calle: How much of the program is free, open and made for joining in.
about.criterion.conectividad: Airport with international or domestic flights serving the place, even if it lies in a neighbouring municipality.
about.criterion.local: Size of the place: in a town, the party belongs to everyone.
about.tier1: {min} points or more: shows in the world view.
about.tier2: {min} to {max}: shows with the Tier 2 switch.
about.provisional: Missing data and its range crosses a threshold.
about.topN.one: Each country always shows its best festival, even below Tier 1.
about.topN.other: Each country always shows its top {count}, even below Tier 1.
about.unmeasured: A criterion without a sourced figure counts as 0, is marked “to be measured” and the total shows as a range.
about.status.confirmada: The organizer or an official source published the date.
about.status.tentativa: Likely date based on past editions; it may change.
about.status.por_anunciar: No date yet; we show the window it usually falls in.
about.status.cancelada: Not happening this edition; shown struck through with its source.
about.freshBody: Festivals are checked more often as they get closer: weekly in the last 45 days, less often further out or once a source confirms the date.
about.staleOn: Verified {when}, on {date}: more than 30 days ago.
about.coverage: Dates sourced from the organizer or government: {share}
about.logEmptyBody: Every applied change shows up here with its date and source.
notfound.title: Page not found
notfound.body: This link doesn't lead anywhere in the app.
notfound.festivalBody: The link may be mistyped, or the festival is no longer published.
